description: List merge requests in a GitLab project by project ID. Returns MR ID, title, state, author, source/target branches, and URL. Filter by state and author.

per_page.description: Number of merge requests to return (default 20, max 100)

project_id.description: Project ID (numeric) or full path "namespace/project" (e.g. "gitlab-org/gitlab") — pass the plain path, do not URL-encode it.

name: gitlab_list_mrs
